title: Proportionate Responsibility
text: In an action to which this chapter applies, a claimant may not recover damages if his percentage of responsibility is greater than 50 percent.
history: Acts 1985, 69th Leg., ch. 959, Sec. 1, eff. Sept. 1, 1985. Amended by Acts 1987, 70th Leg., 1st C.S., ch. 2, Sec. 2.04, eff. Sept. 2, 1987; Acts 1995, 74th Leg., ch. 136, Sec. 1, eff. Sept. 1, 1995.
